neighbours.label: the modifier word of a compound naming a household or building tool or material (measuring cup, frying pan, broom, paving stone, baking tray): the first part of the compound; the same -ing words used as verbs fire less
fire: Grease a shallow baking dish and spread the batter evenly.
Use a measuring spoon to add exactly one teaspoon of salt.
Melt the butter in a heavy frying pan before adding the eggs.
The gardener swept the leaves off the patio with a stiff broom.
They replaced the cracked paving slabs in front of the shop.
Set the hot loaf on a cooling rack and let it rest.
The town built a tall retaining wall beside the new road.
Keep a mixing bowl and a wooden spoon ready on the counter.
quiet: Grease the shallow dish, then the children spread the batter evenly.
Use a small spoon to add exactly one teaspoon of salt.
She was carefully melting the butter before adding the eggs.
The gardener cleared the leaves off the patio by hand this morning.
They replaced the cracked tiles in front of the shop last week.
Set the hot loaf on the counter and let it rest.
The town built a tall fence beside the new road.
She kept mixing the batter until it was completely smooth.

short: first part of a tool/utensil compound noun
notes: Card: ' measuring' (cup), ' frying' (pan), ' bro' (om), ' skys' (craper), ' retaining' (heads/net), ' paving'.
